
  ✓ devbox-2 is set up                           in 3m12s

  Claude Code and Codex are installed and run as the
  agent, an account without sudo that can install
  Ubuntu packages (keelbox install). The box is not on
  your tailnet yet, so SSH from the internet is still
  open. It closes after keelbox login devbox-2
  tailscale, then keelbox apply devbox-2.

╭─ Start working ───────────────────────────────────────╮
│ This computer                                         │
│   keelbox attach devbox-2                             │
│   opens the agent's terminal on the box. Close it and │
│   the work carries on; run it again to come back.     │
│                                                       │
│ Phone over SSH                                        │
│   ssh agent@203.0.113.7 from an SSH app, once your    │
│   phone's key is on the box:                          │
│   https://keelbox.dev/docs/guides/sessions            │
╰───────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Left to do
    join the tailnet: keelbox login devbox-2 tailscale,
      then keelbox apply devbox-2 (closes public SSH)
    sign in to Claude Code (Remote Control starts
      after): keelbox login devbox-2 claude-code
    sign in to Codex: keelbox login devbox-2 codex
    sign in to GitHub: keelbox login devbox-2 gh (until
      then the agent's work stays on devbox-2, unless
      it is pushed another way or copied off)
    git identity: none in the config, and without one
      git on devbox-2 refuses to commit. Add
      users.agent.git: {name: Your Name, email:
      you@example.com} to
      ~/.config/keelbox/boxes/devbox-2.yaml, then
      keelbox apply devbox-2
  Check the box
    keelbox doctor devbox-2
    all boxes: keelbox ls
  Admin shell
    keelbox ssh devbox-2 --admin
    for anything that needs root; the agent has no sudo
